### Readings that hold

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Part of #34601`, with no closing verb anywhere in the body: right, since item 2 continues under the same claim on a second branch (amendment 6939423758), and that PR carries `Fixes #34601`. No `!`, no `(narrowing)`: no dogfood battery owed. `mergeable_state` clean. |
| Scope | 3 files inside the claim's `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/**` and root `.changeset/`: `LookupField.tsx` (one className plus its comment), the existing harness `LookupField.previewBadges-13123.test.tsx` (an optional `{ compact }` on `openPicker` plus a new top-level describe, per AGENTS.md ruling 6583487846), the changeset. |
| The change | `PopoverContent` keeps `w-[var(--radix-popover-trigger-width)]` and adds `min-w-[min(18rem,var(--radix-popover-content-available-width,100vw))]` and `max-w-(--radix-popover-content-available-width)`. Wrapping the floor in `min()` is the needed detail: a bare `min-w-[18rem]` would beat the `max-w` on a screen narrower than 18rem, because CSS lets `min-width` win over `max-width`. The `100vw` fallback covers the frame before Radix sets the variable. `align="start"` and Radix's default collision shift are unchanged. A trigger wider than 18rem gets exactly what it got before. |
| 18rem, not the card's 16rem | Measured and reasoned in the body: 16rem still cut the longest hotcrm catalog name by 6px, and 18rem cut 0/13; 18rem is also `FieldTypePicker`'s floor. The card's figure was a suggestion, so the measurement governs. |
| Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | `no` / `none` in body, changeset and claim. `@object-ui/fields` is published, but no export, prop or type moves: one class string on an internal element. No schema key. |
| Q1 = A (author-pinned width stays exact) | Nothing in this PR touches `GridField` or a column `width`, so the ruling is kept by construction. |
| Docs | No `content/docs`, `skills` or `fields` README sentence describes the lookup picker's width. Nothing is made false. |
| Changeset | Names `@object-ui/fields`, the one package whose `src` moved. Each sentence matches the diff and the Chromium table: trigger width when wider, 18rem floor, capped (floor included) by the room Radix reports, a right-edge panel shifted left, nothing about search/filter/store changed. |
| Tests | Real commands with output: LookupField + GridField 44 files / 347 tests on this head; type-check exit 0 (the test file is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program); dependency-closure build exit 0; 38 derived gates exit 0. The two new pins assert the three classes for a compact and a full trigger. One ablation (deleting the two new classes) turns both red, and the file was restored to the HEAD blob. Pixels are not testable in jsdom; the body's Chromium table (1280, 375, 320 and 260px, including a right-edge cell) is the evidence for the box. |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34658`: NOT governed, 56 lines (+53/−3). Tier S, lands through o3-C. |
| CI on this head | 57 check-runs: all `success` or `skipped`. Test UI (aggregate plus every planned shard), Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core, Check Changeset, PR-body guards (including Part-of), Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are all `success`. |

### Notes

1. **Body text on item 2.** The body says item 2 "ends as an open question for the seat"; amendment 6939423758 has since put item 2 back under this claim on a second branch. The body's instruction that matters, that merging must not close the card, is right. Updating that one phrase is optional; I would not hold landing for it.
2. **Signature trailer.** The plain-text `signed:` line does not affect any L1 reading, and the PR-body guards pass. Whether it should be an HTML comment is the seat's house rule; I don't need it changed.
3. Names longer than 18rem still truncate with no `title` (declared). With the reported catalog every name fits. A tooltip or wrap is a design choice for a later card if it comes up.
